course_name_en: Measurement and Control Engineering (BSc Module 11, MRT)

learning_outcomes.text: Students can name, describe, and explain with examples measurement and control engineering principles for physical quantities.
They can name, analyze, and evaluate system-theoretic properties of dynamic systems.
They can model real systems system-theoretically and evaluate the suitability of established models.
They can apply methods for the synthesis of controllers and analyze and evaluate such parameterized controllers.
They can select measurement principles and model, analyze, and evaluate measuring devices for measuring non-electrical quantities.
They can quantify and assess the measurement uncertainties of measured quantities.

syllabus_topics: Properties of important systems and model building
assessment_rules: The module grade is based on the grade of a 150-minute written examination.
